d: Addressing the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur, Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged young engineers and innovators to shatter limiting beliefs and unlock new possibilities for nation-building. He underscored India's decisive transformation over the past twelve years, citing poverty alleviation achievements, the India Semiconductor Mission, and reforms opening the space domain to private enterprise and youth-led startups like Skyroot Aerospace.
